headline: Jaeha Kim presents interacting electrical and logical UCIe PHY models in SystemVerilog
fact: Scientific Analog hosts Jaeha Kim’s UCIe PHY Modeling and Simulation with XMODEL webinar. The resource page describes SystemVerilog models of PLL, DLL, duty-cycle correction, phase interpolation and transmitter/receiver circuits interacting with logical-layer FSMs. Training examples adjust reference voltages, clock/data timing, lane skew and link data rate using pseudo-random data; FSM coverage can be inspected in SystemVerilog. The materials include a recording, slides and a model package. The stated 4–32-GT/s range concerns model/design requirements, not a measured silicon implementation or UCIe compliance certification.

sources.title: UCIe PHY Modeling and Simulation with XMODEL — webinar and resource record
sources.summary: The June 29, 2023 webinar record identifies Kim and both PHY layers, enumerates modeled blocks and training functions, and lists the recording and model-package resources.
